mapper.select: SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.task.selectTask */ t.TASK_ID AS taskId, t.BOARD_ID AS boardId, t.PROJECT_USER_ID AS projectUserId, t.PROJECT_REPO_ID AS projectRepoId, t.TASK_TITLE AS taskTitle, t.PRIORITY AS priority, t.START_DATE AS startDate, t.END_DATE AS endDate, t.TAGS AS tags, u.USER_NAME AS userName FROM task t JOIN project_user p ON t.project_user_id = p.project_user_id JOIN user u ON u.user_id = p.user_id WHERE t.TASK_ID = #{taskId}

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.task.selectTodoTasksByProjectId */ t.TASK_ID as taskId, t.BOARD_ID as boardId, t.PROJECT_USER_ID as projectUserId, t.PROJECT_REPO_ID as projectRepoId, t.TASK_TITLE as taskTitle, t.PRIORITY as priority, t.START_DATE as startDate, t.END_DATE as endDate, t.TAGS as tags, u.USER_NAME as userName, b.PROJECT_ID as projectId FROM TASK t JOIN BOARD b ON t.BOARD_ID = b.BOARD_ID JOIN PROJECT_USER pu ON t.PROJECT_USER_ID = pu.PROJECT_USER_ID JOIN USER u ON pu.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE b.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} AND b.BOARD_TITLE = '할 일'

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.task.selectUserEmailByProjectUserId */ u.USER_ID as userEmail FROM PROJECT_USER pu JOIN USER u ON pu.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE pu.PROJECT_USER_ID = #{projectUserId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TASK /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.task.insertTask */ ( BOARD_ID, PROJECT_USER_ID, PROJECT_REPO_ID, TASK_TITLE, PRIORITY , START_DATE , END_DATE , TAGS ) VALUES ( #{boardId}, #{projectUserId}, #{projectRepoId}, #{taskTitle}, #{priority} , #{startDate} , #{endDate} , #{tags} )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TASK /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.task.deleteTask */ WHERE TASK_ID = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.task.selectListTask */ TASK_ID as taskId, BOARD_ID as boardId, PROJECT_USER_ID as projectUserId, PROJECT_REPO_ID as projectRepoId, TASK_TITLE as taskTitle, PRIORITY as priority, START_DATE as startDate, END_DATE as endDate, TAGS as tags FROM ( SELECT S.*, CEIL( (@ROWNUM:=@ROWNUM+1) / #{pageSize} ) AS PAGE FROM ( SELECT * FROM TASK WHERE 1=1 AND PROJECT_USER_ID = #{projectUserId} AND BOARD_ID = #{boardId} ) S, (SELECT @ROWNUM := 0) TMP ) A WHERE PAGE = #{pageIndex}

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.task.selectKanbanCardsByProject */ TASK_ID as taskId, BOARD_ID as boardId, PROJECT_USER_ID as projectUserId, PROJECT_REPO_ID as projectRepoId, TASK_TITLE as taskTitle, PRIORITY as priority, START_DATE as startDate, END_DATE as endDate, TAGS as tags FROM TASK WHERE 1=1 AND PROJECT_USER_ID = #{projectUserId} AND BOARD_ID = #{boardId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.task.selectCardCountByBoard */ BOARD_ID as boardId, COUNT(*) as cardCount FROM TASK WHERE 1=1 AND PROJECT_USER_ID = #{projectUserId} GROUP BY BOARD_ID ORDER BY BOARD_ID

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.task.selectTaskListWithUserName */ t.TASK_ID as taskId, t.BOARD_ID as boardId, t.PROJECT_USER_ID as projectUserId, t.PROJECT_REPO_ID as projectRepoId, t.TASK_TITLE as taskTitle, t.PRIORITY as priority, t.START_DATE as startDate, t.END_DATE as endDate, t.TAGS as tags, u.USER_NAME as userName FROM TASK t JOIN PROJECT_USER pu ON t.PROJECT_USER_ID = pu.PROJECT_USER_ID JOIN USER u ON pu.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND t.PROJECT_USER_ID = #{projectUserId} AND t.BOARD_ID = #{boardId} ORDER BY t.START_DATE DESC
